title: Proportions: the store's one double door
about: Day 3, 10:00, the dry town: the farmer in the store's forecourt facing its door, Mara at her spot. The store has one double door (30 px wide, a 28 px frame on a 2 px step) over its three door cells and a hanging sign west of it (owner: "the town store has 3 doors"); the shop's trigger is still the three cells.
